title: MULTIVAC Celebrates 50th Anniversary
content: The company was founded in 1961 by Sepp Haggenmüller in Böhen in the Allgäu and has since developed into a leading global fullrange supplier of packaging solutions for food, sterile medical products and various industrial goods. Today the MULTIVAC Group has more than 3,000 employees worldwide, including over 1,300 at its headquarters in Wolfertschwenden (Allgäu). It all began with the first MULTIVAC chamber machine which Sepp Haggenmüller built in 1961. From the seventies onwards, the machine manufacturer from Allgäu began to develop his machine designs with groundbreaking innovations in the direction of resources conservation, hygienic design and consumer protection, which was pioneering at the time. Today, the name MULTIVAC is synonomous with thermoforming packaging machines: more than half of the thermoforming packaging machines worldwide come from the machine manufacturer from Allgäu. **International Expansion and New Markets**At the end of the sixties, MULTIVAC started developing packaging solutions for sterile medical goods and led the market as a result.

title: MULTIVAC Marks 50 Years In Business - Bakers Journal
content: # MULTIVAC marks 50 years in business. Since it was founded by Sepp Haggenmüller in 1961, MULTIVAC has developed into a full-range supplier of automated packaging solutions. Haggenmüller built the first MULTIVAC chamber machine in 1961. In 1966 and 1967, the first thermoforming machines followed, marking an international breakthrough for Haggenmüller and his partners. In the early nineties, the tray sealer was added to MULTIVAC’s packaging machine ranges, making it possible to seal pre-fabricated trays and tubs. In addition to packaging machines, handling solutions for loading and unloading as well as the separation of packets, quality inspection systems for detecting quality faults and foreign objects in the packs are now part of the machine manufacturer's portfolio. The MULTIVAC Group has more than 3,000 employees worldwide, including over 1,300 at its headquarters in Wolfertschwenden. content: # Busch Vacuum Solutions’ Post. Busch & MULTIVAC Group : 60 Years of Partnership Busch and MULTIVAC were both founded in the early 1960s when vacuum packaging was born – a new method to preserve fresh food. The company entered the market with its first vacuum chamber machine at the beginning of the 1960s and developed the first internationally successful thermoforming packaging machine. With the robust and particularly space-saving HUCKEPACK, Dr Karl Busch developed the first vacuum pump specifically designed to package food. The successor product, the R5, set a new industrial standard and made the company the world market leader in vacuum packaging. Today, Busch is one of the world’s largest providers of vacuum solutions. We are proud to look back on 60 years of innovation and to continue shaping the future of packaging technology together with Busch🤝. Enjoy shaping the future Busch Vacuum Solutions! title: About us - Multivac
content: ### MULTIVAC - Packaging and processing solutions designed and built for your success. Packaging machines & packaging technology, automation solutions & processing technology, labelling and inspection systems, portioning and slicing - and, since the takeover of the FRITSCH Group, bakery technology as well. For more than 60 years, MULTIVAC has been one of the leading manufacturers of packaging machines. Company headquarters - as well as the nucleus of the now global MULTIVAC Group - are located in Wolfertschwenden, Germany. 16 production sites, state-of-the-art Application Centers, best-in-class service and support, comprehensive advice and intelligent logistics ensure that all MULTIVAC solutions are successfully deployed worldwide. Founded in 1961 in a small garage in Böhen and now firmly rooted in the idyllic German region of Allgäu, our group of companies has quickly developed into a global player and a trusted provider of integrated solutions. sales and service companies are part of the MULTIVAC Group.
